title: briqyard: fleet
description: Every host through the fleet: their state, the machines, the room left per region, events.

panels.title: Hosts by state
panels.description: Hosts in the fleet's registry, by state.

panels.title: Hosts answering
panels.description: Hosts whose metrics the fleet relayed at the last scrape, and those it could not.

panels.title: Hosts with a condition
panels.description: Hosts with a condition true (memory_pressure, disk_pressure…): the fleet places no new tenant there.

panels.title: Machines
panels.description: Machines on every host, gateways included.

panels.title: Tenants
panels.description: Tenants with a machine or a gateway on a host.

panels.title: Endpoints
panels.description: Ports of machines served by the hosts' ingress.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: Each host now: its state in the registry, whether it answers, what it runs and how full it is. A host's name opens its dashboard.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (briqyard_memory_mb{kind="used", region=~"$region"}) / sum by (host) (briqyard_memory_mb{kind="capacity", region=~"$region"})
sum by (host) (briqyard_pool_bytes{kind="used", region=~"$region"}) / sum by (host) (briqyard_pool_bytes{kind="size", region=~"$region"})

panels.title: Host conditions
panels.description: Each host condition over time: red while true.

panels.title: Running, asleep, stopped
panels.description: Machines running; stopped for idleness (asleep: the next use wakes them); stopped for another reason (asked, their process ended, or the host stopped them).

panels.title: Machines by state
panels.description: Every machine by its state now, gateways included; error in red.

panels.title: Memory: committed and capacity
panels.description: Memory reserved by running machines against what the region's hosts hand out (MiB).

panels.title: vCPUs: committed and capacity
panels.description: vCPUs of running machines against what the region's hosts hand out.

panels.title: Memory committed, per region
panels.description: Committed over capacity. Placement stops at a host's fill ceiling (0.85 by default); memory_pressure at 95 %.

targets.expr: sum by (region) (briqyard_memory_mb{kind="used", region=~"$region"}) / sum by (region) (briqyard_memory_mb{kind="capacity", region=~"$region"})

panels.title: Free room: memory
panels.description: Free memory on the region's hosts that take a new tenant, summed, and the most on one of them: the largest machine the region still takes.

panels.title: Free room: disk
panels.description: Free pool space on the region's hosts that take a new tenant, summed, and the most on one of them.

panels.title: Creates refused for want of room
panels.description: Creates answered 503 capacity, by region and what ran out: memory or disk (a new host helps) or pressure (the tenant's host must be freed).

panels.title: Events by type
panels.description: Events the hosts logged, per interval: normal, and warnings (a failed start, a crash loop, a probe failing, a quota refused).

panels.title: Warnings by reason
panels.description: Warning events per interval, by reason.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (increase(briqyard_events_total{type="warning", region=~"$region"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "reason", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Events in the range, by reason
panels.description: Every event of the time range, by reason, most frequent first.
